about_the_game:
Dive into an environmental puzzle game where logic and exploration guide your every step.
You play as a small flying drone with a unique ability: hacking into and taking control of other robots you encounter along the way. Each robot comes with different skills that you must use to overcome obstacles, activate mechanisms, and solve increasingly complex puzzles.

This demo features 4 handcrafted levels, with the first one serving as a tutorial to introduce the core mechanics. The playtime ranges from 40 to 60 minutes, depending on how much you explore—those who dig deeper will also find hidden optional puzzles that expand the experience.

Whether you aim straight for the goal or take your time uncovering every secret, each level is crafted to spark curiosity and creativity.

Key Features

  • Play as a flying drone with the ability to control other robots.

  • Use each robot’s unique abilities to solve environmental puzzles.

  • Explore 4 handcrafted levels, including a tutorial introduction.

  • Find hidden optional puzzles for players who love to explore.

  • Find all the chests and collectibles

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 (2.8 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (3.2 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / AMD RX 560 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 (3.6 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X (3.7 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 super 8 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
